Nanopb message types for instruction accounts, context, effects, and fixtures.

# Purpose
This nanopb header defines the message layout for instruction test data used by the Solana Sealevel execution path. It declares the `fd_exec_test_instr_acct_t`, `fd_exec_test_instr_context_t`, `fd_exec_test_instr_effects_t`, and `fd_exec_test_instr_fixture_t` structures, which together describe an instruction input, the accounts it can access, the execution result, and the full test fixture wrapper. The file also provides field tags, nanopb field lists, default initializers, and message descriptors so the codebase can encode and decode these messages in a fixed Protobuf format. It serves as the generated interface between C code and the serialized test metadata used to replay and verify instruction execution.
